output.summary: A deciduous small tree or shrub native to the Hyrcanian forests south of the Caspian Sea in Iran. It bears aromatic golden-yellow fruit that remains hard, tart and astringent when ripe; most varieties are cooked into jams, jellies or puddings, though a few can be eaten raw.
output.edibilityNote: Ripe fruit is eaten raw or processed into preserves and drinks; most varieties are too hard and tart raw. Seeds are toxic in large quantities.
